# Cvbliss

> Cvbliss is an AI-powered resume and cover letter builder for job seekers.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://cvbliss.in/): Resume building platform overview and product entry points.
- [Resume Builder](https://cvbliss.in/resume): Create and edit a professional resume.
- [Improve CV](https://cvbliss.in/improve-cv): Analyze and improve an existing resume.
- [ATS Checker](https://cvbliss.in/ats-checker): Check resume compatibility with applicant tracking systems.
- [Cover Letter Builder](https://cvbliss.in/cover-letter): Create and improve cover letters.
- [Resume Templates](https://cvbliss.in/templates): Browse available resume and cover letter templates.
- [Career Blog](https://cvbliss.in/interview): Read interview, resume, and career guidance articles.
- [Plans](https://cvbliss.in/plans): View available product plans.
- [Contact](https://cvbliss.in/contact): Contact the Cvbliss team.

## Content Guidance

- Prefer publicly accessible pages listed above.
- Do not access or index admin, dashboard, profile, authentication, payment, or user-specific pages.
- Blog article pages are available through the Career Blog index.
